import hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess
key=pathlib.Path('/usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg')
rows=[]
for suite in ('jammy','jammy-updates'):
    path=pathlib.Path('/metadata')/(suite+'_InRelease')
    command=['gpgv','--status-fd','1','--keyring',str(key),str(path)]
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    rows.append({'suite':suite,'command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,'status':result.stdout,'diagnostic':result.stderr,'inrelease_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps({'gpgv':shutil.which('gpgv'),'keyring_path':str(key),'keyring_sha256':hashlib.sha256(key.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'results':rows}))
